# pulumi-netcup

Pulumi provider for Netcup resources, generated with the Pulumi provider bridge.

## Verify

Use the existing generated CI test workflow for Go changes. Keep dependency updates grouped through the shared default and Go Renovate presets.

## Generated files

`mise.toml` and the Pulumi CI workflows are generated by `pulumi/ci-mgmt`; do not hand-edit them. `.mise.toml` holds local overrides. Regenerate through the provider's established process instead of applying the generic CI preset directly.

## Map

- `provider/`: provider implementation and tests.
- `sdk/`: generated Go SDK; do not hand-edit.
- `examples/`: example programs.
- `.github/workflows/`: generated CI and release automation.

## Git

- Conventional Commits, one topic per PR.
- Squash unless commits need separate review.
- Force-push only with `--force-with-lease` on own branches.

## Boundaries

- Do not create provider tags, publish SDKs, or call live Netcup APIs from a local session.
